I believe the notion of a mindless body that behaves exactly like a conscious being with thoughts and feelings is nonsensical. Consciousness cannot be separated from its physical manifestations. Zombies are logically impossible and incoherent, therefore I reject their metaphysical possibility.
My interests include existentialism, linguistics and playing violin. What is your view on the following topic: Zombies
 (A) inconceivable
 (B) conceivable but not metaphysically possible
 (C) metaphysically possible
